description: This is a 3D model preview of a set of modern, minimalist stairs. The stairs appear to be made of a solid material, possibly concrete or metal, with a smooth, matte finish. The design is clean and geometric, with sharp edges and a lack of ornamentation. The stairs are viewed from a low angle, suggesting a descent into a space. The perspective indicates a sense of depth and scale, with the steps receding into the background. The overall impression is one of sleekness and functionality, suitable for contemporary architectural designs.
